prior_strict_attempt.finding_preserved: No complete source-backed selectable HSR action joins legal action, target, full effect closure, action completion, scheduler progression and Terra publication.

action_envelope.identity: SHA-256 over domain-separated canonical-v2 envelope document
required: explicit local resource cost equal to the packet debit
action_envelope.legal_completeness: COMPLETE_FOR_SUPPORTED_SCOPE means complete for the caller-declared ordered local envelopes for the current actor. It is not a complete HSR skill list. Each envelope is read-only preflighted for cost, target, exact REF02 settlement, real mutation, nonlethal continuation and ordinary scheduler closure; any blocker suppresses the entire view.
action_envelope.packet_gate: OrdinaryReferencePacket.from_dict and ReferenceAdapterGate.require reject unsupported fields, packet shape, owner, scope and version/hash mismatches before publication.
action_envelope.fixture: tests/game_data/test_reference_damage_v2.py:packet, instantiated with two explicit synthetic participants; no source-backed character or native action claim

session_state.write_policy: A versioned complete reference combat/timeline payload is appended once per committed action. The latest ordinal is the local session state; every prior ordinal is retained and validated.
session_state.initial_policy: The supplied CustomScenario contains a complete Terra initial state with empty typed and opaque stores and a NON_TERMINAL empty-side policy; conflicting or unresolved initial families block. Reference combat entities, resource, ordinary timeline, speeds, envelopes and terminal bound are supplied explicitly.
session_state.snapshot_hash: TerraSnapshotV2 plus semantic_hash_v2 covers the store payload, revision, RNG, allocator and local policy identity.

completion_schedule_terminal.completion_meaning: Only after the complete declared reference settlement passes and commits, a local SUCCESS task is supplied to the reference ordinary scheduler. This does not evidence native HSR action completion.
completion_schedule_terminal.schedule_inputs: Explicit ordinary action order, delays and positive speeds; pending inserted/special actions are absent from this local scope.
completion_schedule_terminal.scheduler: SemanticExecutor.advance_ordinary_after_completed_action using an explicit local SUCCESS TaskStep; next actor remains REFERENCE_MODEL calculation over local inputs.
completion_schedule_terminal.terminal_meaning: The caller-declared positive max_actions produces CONTINUE or CUSTOM_TERMINAL. It is not official Stage victory.
unsupported: pending inserted or special scheduler arbitration

publication.preflight: Legal view, selected envelope, explicit target, REF02 settlement and ordinary next-turn transition all complete on private values before Terra candidate construction.
publication.commit: Append one local scenario_runtime payload and advance Terra published revision, replay sequence and effect sequence exactly once; RNG and allocator are copied unchanged.
publication.rejection: The immutable source session, Terra state, combat payload, hash, revision, RNG, allocator, turn and completion history remain byte-identical.

replay.method: Reconstruct the complete session from serialized spec and initial snapshot, then independently execute every selected action and compare the full canonical step record.
checks: ordinary scheduler state and next actor
